company.shortDescription: Elip is a conversational job-search agent that matches roles and creates tailored résumés through WhatsApp.
company.description: Elip provides a conversational job-search agent that operates through WhatsApp. The service interprets a user's job criteria, analyzes job listings, filters out irrelevant and suspected ghost postings, and returns matched opportunities. It also generates résumés tailored to individual roles and formatted for applicant tracking systems. Elip is intended for job seekers and supports recruitment workflows through chat-based interaction. Employers pay fees when hires are completed, while individual applicants use the service without charge.
